name: RFiD Discovery USA & Canada
old_description: RFiD Discovery is a leading provider of integrated location tracking solutions using latest technologies including active and passive RFID, BLE, UWB, GPS, Wi-Fi and more.
about:
RFiD Discovery operates from Essex Junction, Vermont, as the North American arm of RFiD Discovery Solutions Ltd, a subsidiary of Paragon ID. The company was established as a trading name for RFID tracking solutions, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership rests with Paragon ID, a global identification solutions group.

The firm delivers integrated location-tracking systems that combine active and passive RFID, Bluetooth Low Energy, ultra-wideband, GPS, Wi-Fi, and LoRa technologies. As an independent systems provider, it designs and deploys hardware-software platforms for asset tracking, inventory management, work-in-progress monitoring, and personnel safety across facilities. The company cites a 15-year track record in healthcare RFID and deployments in over 100 hospitals across the UK and Europe.

Customers span healthcare, manufacturing, logistics, oil and gas, construction, retail, mining, and aviation. Reference installations include syringe-pump tracking for North Midlands NHS Trust, R&D inventory management for Sanofi, medical-device auditing for Gateshead Health NHS Foundation Trust, and garment container verification for clothing manufacturer Brook Taverner.

The company differentiates itself through a technology-agnostic approach that selects the optimal mix of tracking methods for each application, backed by Paragon ID's ISO 9001, 14001, 27001, and 45001 certifications. Its independent status allows it to combine best-of-breed hardware with proprietary software rather than locking clients into a single vendor ecosystem.
